data.description:
## What
Write tests that verify the replay harness performs a corpus quality check before replay: incidents referencing ticket_ids that do not exist (per ticket-exists CLI) are flagged and excluded from recall computation, and a warning is emitted.

## Why
Story consideration: 'a low-quality corpus (misclassified incidents, unverified ticket-ids) will produce spurious recall failures; implementation plan should include a corpus quality check before replay.'

## Test file
tests/test-inference-recall-replay.sh (same file as T1+T2)

## Test cases
- All incidents have valid ticket-ids → 0 exclusions, no warning
- 2 of 12 incidents reference non-existent ticket-ids → those 2 excluded from denominator, CORPUS_QUALITY_WARNING emitted on stderr with count
- After exclusion, if remaining corpus < 10 → CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT emitted

## How to stub ticket-exists
In test, set TICKET_EXISTS_CMD to a shell function/script that returns exit 0 for known ids, exit 1 for unknown ids (via temp dir script). The harness reads TICKET_EXISTS_CMD env var with default .claude/scripts/dso ticket exists.

## Acceptance criteria
- Tests fail (RED) before harness supports quality check
- Uses mktemp for all fixtures
- Only checks observable outputs (stderr warning text, exit codes, signal emission)
data.title: RED: test inference-recall replay corpus quality check rejects incidents with unverified ticket-ids
